sbh2.6:4.11: Printed *romakūpāni pāḥ*; read *romakūpāni* (Xuanzang 一切毛孔, T1579 juan 27).
sbh2.6:6.3: Printed *aśithila-*, here and at 6.4; read *atiśithila-* 'over-slack' (Xuanzang 太緩, T1579 juan 27).
sbh2.6:6.16: Printed *prāgasau na vā*, corrupt; the sense follows Xuanzang 極重 (T1579 juan 27).
sbh2.6:9.32: Printed *uttarāt*; read *antarāt* 'in the meantime' (9.21, 9.34; Xuanzang 於其中間, T1579 juan 27).
sbh2.6:9.36: Printed *gadhayāt*, corrupt; the sense follows Xuanzang 極串習故 (T1579 juan 27).
sbh2.6:9.43: Printed *vyākṣepasthānaṁ*; read *vyākṣepasthāne* 'where there is distraction' (Xuanzang 於散亂處, T1579 juan 27).
sbh2.6:9.46: Printed *priyārohatā*; read *apriyārohatā* 'no liking for taking up' (9.48; Xuanzang 不好乘, T1579 juan 27).
sbh2.6:11.7: Printed text omits the question and answer on the life-faculty's condition; not supplied (Xuanzang 命根依緣先行, T1579 juan 27).
sbh2.6:11.8: Printed *pūrvakaḥ saṁskāraḥ* alone; the question's predicate is supplied on the pattern of 11.6 (Xuanzang 先行何依何緣, T1579 juan 27).
sbh2.6:11.10: Printed *sarva-*; read *pūrva-* (11.9; Xuanzang 先行, T1579 juan 27).
sbh2.6:12.3: Printed text omits *bhavanti bhūtvā ca* after *abhūtvā ca*; supplied from 12.4–12.5 (Xuanzang 本無而有，有已散滅, T1579 juan 27).
sbh2.6:15.3: Printed *dṛṣṭaprapavādo*; read *dṛṣṭapadaḥ* 'who has seen the footing' (Xuanzang 見迹, T1579 juan 27).
sbh2.6:15.20: Printed *sitām*, corrupt; Xuanzang has only 空無位、遠離位 (T1579 juan 27).
sbh2.6:17.5: Printed *manthita*; read *manyita* 'conceiving' (Xuanzang 慢, T1579 juan 27; cf. SN 35.248:3.1 *maññitam*).
sbh2.6:18.10: Printed *saṁpradīpayati*; read *saṁpraharṣayati* 'gladdens' (18.11; Xuanzang 慶喜, T1579 juan 27).
sbh2.6:18.12: Printed *nivṛttaṁ*; read *nivṛtaṁ* 'covered' (Xuanzang 蓋覆障, T1579 juan 27).
sbh2.6:20.4: Printed *paricayaḥ*; read *pratisaṁcayaḥ* 'adding to' (cf. AN 6.55:11.4 *katassa vā paṭicayaṁ*).
sbh2.6:21.3: Printed *savyokṣepam*; read *savikṣepam* 'where there is distraction' (Xuanzang 有散亂, T1579 juan 27).
